author_definition: A person or organization that uses professional advice or services from a person or business.
exact_refined_definition: A person or organization that receives professional advice or services.
refinement_scope: definition only; existing candidate B1 retained
decision: Accept this exact replacement for the ordinary professional-services sense.
meaning: Receives professional advice or services preserves the selected service relationship without requiring ongoing support, payment, or a provider that is specifically a business. Person or organization is supported by the head sense together with corporate-client examples.
grammar: The singular person or organization correctly takes that receives. Professional can modify the coordinated advice or services. The wording is concise, grammatical and suitable as a learner definition.
course_breadth: Removing from a person or business avoids unnecessarily excluding professional services offered by public or nonprofit organizations. This is a bounded editorial inference from the source organization wording and social-work examples, not an assertion that the dictionary lists every provider sector.

difficulty.excluded: Computing C2 and unrelated page-footer levels are not transferred.

example.text: The client requested an update on the project.
example.decision: Still natural for the selected service relationship; no change required by this definition refinement.

boundaries: Customer and client remain overlapping usage categories; no goods-versus-services partition is introduced.
This finding concerns the exact definition refinement only and does not approve other author candidates, morphology, media, professional relationship classification or module readiness.
